items: Beautiful DISPALY AND ANDROID SYSTEM — Vivid 10.1” incell screen with 1280*800 resolution and dual speakers, powered by the newest Android 14 operating system (with GMS certification) for 2026, ideal for seamless streaming, reading, and gaming.

Excellent PERFORMANCE — Built with a powerful MTK8781V octa-core processor,16 GB memory(8GB physical + 8GB virtual), and dual Wi-Fi 2.4G/5G for fast streaming, web browsing, gaming, and quick multitasking

All-day ENTERTAINMENT — With 18-hour battery life, maximize your downtime for reading, browsing the web, watching videos, and listening to music at home and on-the-go. Save your favorites with 128 GB storage, and expand to up to 1 TB with TF card (sold separately).
Playful GAMING TABLET — With the MTK8786 octa-core processor easily conquer all games, to use this android tablet as a game station with 10.1-inch HD display to maximizing your gaming experience.

Versatile FOR WORK AND PLAY — Thoughtfully packed bluetooth keyboard, mouse set, tablet case and stylus pen, screen protector, with this android tablet set you can get everything you need at once. Get a portable work station!

Clear COMMUNICATION WITH DUAL CAMERA — The 8 MP front camera makes for clear calls to friends and family on Zoom. The 13 MP back camera makes for clear picture taking to save your bills and invoice and tickets.

Diversity IN MULTIPLE SCENARIOS — Built-in GPS enables use with various navigation apps, with split-screen functionality, GPS, and privacy protection, this android tablet supports wireless projection as well, it meets the diverse needs of every user.
Ideal GIFT SET FOR THE LOVED ONES.
